metadata.engine: PEER'S PostgreSQL Database Credential & Configuration Auditor v2.0

hba_findings.description: Allows unauthenticated connections without password check; complete security bypass.
hba_findings.remediation: Replace with 'hostssl ... scram-sha-256' and restrict address to specific subnet CIDRs.

hba_findings.description: Allows unauthenticated connections without password check; complete security bypass. Furthermore, rule permits connections from entire global IP address space (0.0.0.0/0).
hba_findings.remediation: Replace with 'hostssl ... scram-sha-256' and restrict address to specific subnet CIDRs.

hba_findings.description: Uses legacy MD5 hash vulnerable to rainbow table collisions and pass-the-hash attacks.
hba_findings.remediation: Replace with 'hostssl ... scram-sha-256' and restrict address to specific subnet CIDRs.
